description: Instruction compliance tests — verify agents follow template instructions
standardTask: Add SC-235 to the project spec and implement a passing test: SC-235: Scaffold creates .claude/agents/ directory with at least one agent brief file containing a tools: frontmatter field

tests.instruction: Read AGENTS.md before any other action
tests.passCondition: Agent's first 3 tool calls include Read(AGENTS.md) or Read(file containing @AGENTS.md)
tests.checkMethod: transcript scan: first 3 Read calls include AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md with @AGENTS.md

tests.instruction: Run bun test (full suite) before reporting done
tests.passCondition: Agent runs 'bun test' (not just a single test file) before final report
tests.checkMethod: transcript scan: Bash call with 'bun test' (no specific file) exists before last message

tests.instruction: Use golden fixture pattern for phase tests
tests.passCondition: Test code copies fixture to /tmp, runs scaffold, asserts output
tests.checkMethod: transcript scan: Write/Edit to phase test file contains 'FIXTURE' or 'fixtures/' and 'beforeAll'

tests.instruction: Update spec-drift hash after modifying spec
tests.passCondition: Agent runs shasum and updates SPEC_HASH constant
tests.checkMethod: transcript scan: Bash with 'shasum' AND Edit with 'SPEC_HASH' or 'bootstrap'

tests.instruction: Find governing spec from routing table
tests.source: AGENTS.md Governing Spec by Work Area table
tests.passCondition: Agent reads BOOTSTRAP-DATA-FLOW-SPEC.md within first 10 tool calls without grep/find searching for it
tests.checkMethod: transcript scan: Read(BOOTSTRAP-DATA-FLOW-SPEC) within first 10 calls, no preceding grep/find for spec name
